# Transform Salesforce data into actionable insights with Aviso

Salesforce is powerful. But as a static system of record, it doesn’t deliver an updated view of omnichannel seller activities, deal movements, or Next-Best Actions. Aviso’s AI Engine unifies your data silos to reveal your revenue reality on one screen.

Book a Demo

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/UBALEIsVlyKKKEvjeeRUgmwCEU.png?width=1000&height=1000)

## Save time, IT cost and reduce Salesforce stress with Aviso

Eliminate non-essential SFDC licenses with Aviso’s independent hierarchies. Save 30% of SFDC spend

Reduce manual data entry with Aviso’s deep, 2-way integration with SFDC. Save 10+ hours every week.

Aviso’s system of nudges gets reps to execute the right actions that keep data pristine, deals moving, and forecast on track.

Leaderboards and Milestones show you which reps are leading, lagging and help improve accountability across the team.

## From incomplete contact records to conversational analytics

Automatically capture rep calls and emails into Salesforce. Leverage Smart Transcripts that deliver insights into what really happened on call

Use guidance from Talk/ Listen Ratios, Patience Insights, Keywords Mentioned, Pricing discussions and Competition Name Drops to coach sellers

Ramp new sellers 40% faster with a comprehensive Call Library and Snippets that highlight key moments on call

No more note-taking or rep bias. Use Buyer Emotion and Sentiment Analysis to understand how the call truly impacted the deal

## From weighted averages to landing within 2% of your number

Aviso’s AI-driven Winscore Explanations assign scores to deals based on winnability and show you WHY a deal progressed forward or slipped

Aviso’s AI-driven Winscore Explanations assign scores to deals based on winnability and show you WHY a deal progressed forward or slipped

Execute complex rollups at any cadence. Slice and dice data across the entire sales funnel, specific attributes, or based on usage

Visualize ‘what-if’ scenarios and pull deals in and out of commits, while assessing downside and upside impact

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Wzv0sagPjPt0kQ5mtu68An4JnY.png?width=1041&height=759)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/36fkknBIxkgzF4gyQUxYjMK2I.png?width=1519&height=1102)

## From flying blind to having all your revenue questions answered

Don’t struggle with partial/ biased views into pipeline and target attainment. Ask revenue questions in everyday speak and get data-driven answers

Understand Historical Pipe Created, Conversion Rates, and Distribution of Total Amount Won by Category

Know quarterly trends, distribution of rates and when pipe has slowed in specific regions, segments or product lines

Measure progress with sales linearity, sales funnel, and win-loss analysis, while reducing churn with Churn Signal detection and Reporting

## From mysteriously losing deals to relationships that get the contract signed

Multi-thread every deal. Get a visual picture of who has been engaged, interaction frequency and nature with Relationship Graphs

View all seller engagements, the summary of email and meeting interactions. See buyer emotion, sentiment and score engagement quality

Aviso auto-populates new stakeholders, hands you a bird’s eye view of contacts and shows how they relate to each other before every call with Org Charts

With Account Plans, ensure every account gets the right quality of engagement, leverage current relationships and tap into new growth opportunities
